newsitem.title: UK: Firm UK meals offers keep buyers sidelined.
newsitem.headline: Firm UK meals offers keep buyers sidelined.

text.p: Buyers remained firmly dug in on the sidelines of the UK meals and feeds market on Monday following a surge in Chicago prices at the end of last week.
High protein soymeal sellers were as much as 14 stg a tonne up with rapemeal up to four stg higher.
In thin trading spot EU sunflower meal traded at 97 stg for spot ex-store Teignmouth while 134 stg was paid for spot EU rapemeal on the south coast.
Brokers reported a lot of interest in corn gluten in Liverpool and Avonmouth.
"Some people are getting concerned as to when the as-available material will actually arrive," said one broker.
High protein soymeal sellers were 2.50 to 14 stg up while rape meal ex-mill Erith was two to three stg higher.
Material from the Liverpool and Hull mills was two to four stg higher.
Sunflower meals and pellets were unchanged while corn gluten feed pellets were unchanged to one stg up. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8062
